pages.title: The Store in Your Hand
pages.text: Successfully open a connected network using a wireless terminal.

pages.title: The Store in Your Hand
pages.text: Reach your own supplies away from the wall-mounted terminal.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Craft a Wireless Terminal, bind it to your network using its item instructions and open storage within its allowed range. Native distance and access rules still apply.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Sneak-right-click a terminal with the Advanced Wireless Terminal. Bind remote access subject to configured range, loaded chunks and beacon extensions.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Configure link ends to provide or access remote inventories and choose their private/public channel. Connect networks subject to both endpoint chunks being loaded; beacon extensions follow configured levels.
